- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To determine the time it takes to charge the battery, the output of the charger (40 amps) is multiplied by the battery voltage (12 volts) to get 480 watts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The wattage (480) is divided by the battery capacity (2400) to get the time it takes to charge the battery (5 hours).
